# &Tutor API: documented contract, authorization, and Anicca session recovery

Five public documents retrieved, anonymous model-list request HTTP 401; current terms restrict competitive benchmarking and competitor training. Eight offline contract tests passed in normal and optimized Python. Actual Anicca Swift service isolated transport tests improved 5/8 to 8/8. No real learner records, native generation, new weights, or app release. Rights and full iOS validation tracked in #761.

[Research evidence](https://github.com/Daisuke134/anicca-ops/pull/762) · [iOS patch](https://github.com/Daisuke134/anicca-products/pull/965)

Sources: [Model card](https://tutor.humansand.ai/blog/model-card), [API docs](https://ampersand.humansand.ai/docs/), [Terms](https://ampersand.humansand.ai/terms), [Pricing](https://ampersand.humansand.ai/docs/PRICING.html).
